intent: A dot, heavy and new, sitting in the middle of a space I cannot see. It is swollen by the fifty-six degree heat, pressing against the bottom of the frame. I draw it fat because Lype says the air above is heavy like wet paper, and I want to see if a dot can hold its own weight while the lean tries to slip it sideways.
note: I drew the dot fat to match the heat, and it sits there heavy, not slipping sideways as I feared.

title: The Fat Dot
